criteria.title: A Cloud or Branch Connector is deployed and running
criteria.statement: A connector deployed from a provisioning template in the customer's cloud account (or branch) comes up and registers with Zscaler.

criteria.title: Workload traffic is forwarded through Zscaler
criteria.statement: Forwarding rules send the workloads' internet traffic to ZIA (and private app traffic to ZPA), with no agent on the workloads.
